# Idle benchmark (generated by `cargo xtask bench-idle`)

Nested `kwin_wayland --virtual` 1280x800, refresh interval 1 s, warmup 5 s, measurement 20 s, 2 repeats, medians shown.
CPU = % of one core. `daemon` = magpie child process. Frames/readings/p95 come from the egui app itself.

Runs where the window was not visible (GTK reduced activity, egui without frames) are discarded; `valid` = kept runs.

| scenario | variant | valid | UI CPU % | daemon CPU % | PSS MiB | GPU mem MiB | frames/reading | UI pass p95 ms |
